svg.title: Anhedral progressive application stack
svg.desc: Begin with Next.js and OpenNext on Cloudflare Workers. Add Hono, then Drizzle, D1 and Better Auth. Independently add private R2, events, RTC, Workers AI, Expo with native UI, WXT with Chrome Side Panel support, GPUI, Stripe and RevenueCat. RevenueCat requires Expo and Stripe. UI source and shared theme tokens support web and native applications.
svg.text: Configure the authentication methods you need
CHOOSE OPTIONAL ADDITIONS AFTER THE CORE FOUNDATION
Web: shadcn/ui · Native: React Native Reusables + Anhedral extensions · Shared theme tokens
Editable source at every step. Provision, configure, validate and deploy when ready.
